tools.name: plan_meeting_schedule
tools.description: Plans a one-off or recurring meeting with people in other time zones when its time is known (e.g. "every other Tuesday at 10:00 Berlin time with Anna in Tbilisi"). Expands it into concrete dates and shows each one in every participant's local time, with working-hours checks, public holidays and dayl

tools.name: find_meeting_windows
tools.description: Finds when people in other time zones can meet, when the time is not decided yet: the windows on each day when all participants are within their working hours, accounting for weekends, public holidays and daylight-saving changes, and one suggested start time that fits the most days.
